effects.name: Carimbo voador
effects.subject: The same wooden round-handled rectangular black rubber stamp with crimson-red ink pad as the character reference; isolated prop, gently tumbling during flight, no person.

effects.name: Impacto do carimbo
effects.subject: Crimson rubber-stamp ink impact, small sharp comic ink star and red droplets; no stamp, no person, transparent gaps between ink marks.
poses: last few tiny fading ink flecks

effects.name: Cerca surgindo
effects.subject: Narrow dark gray wrought-iron barrier with three vertical bars, two crossbars and a taller thin central signpost carrying a cream rectangular BLANK placard. Same fence across all drawings, anchored at ground baseline.
poses: barrier begins rising from ground, upper bar visible

effects.name: Cerca — três níveis de resistência
effects.subject: Same narrow dark gray iron fence: three vertical bars, two horizontal crossbars and tall signpost with cream BLANK placard. Shape and size fixed; show progressive damage.
poses: completely intact fence, three upright bars
one cracked and bent bar, light damage
one cracked bar, small fleck falling
two badly bent cracked bars, heavy damage
two broken bent bars and signpost tilted, about to collapse

effects.name: Cerca quebrando
effects.subject: Same narrow gray iron barrier with tall signpost and cream BLANK sign breaking apart, separate object FX, no people.
poses: broken iron fragments pile near baseline
small settled pile of iron and cream sign fragments

effects.name: Cabine — queda e aterrissagem
effects.subject: Blue portable chemical toilet cabin with white curved roof, darker blue corrugated door, silver hinges, small red latch and large cream BLANK rectangular notice plate in upper third of door. Front/three-quarter fixed view; width about half height; the SAME single cabin in each cell.
poses: upright cabin tilted slightly backward, descending
cabin compresses slightly on landing, roof vibrates
cabin settles with tiny opposite wobble

effects.name: Cabine — cinco pontos de resistência
effects.subject: Same blue portable toilet with white roof, darker blue corrugated door, red latch, cream BLANK notice in upper third. Fixed camera and external size. Six successive durability states.
poses: HP4 first small crack on door
HP3 two visible door cracks and a dent
HP2 long fractures and one bent hinge
HP1 heavily cracked door and loose roof, still upright
HP0 broken door partly detached and roof slumping

effects.name: Cabine desabando
effects.subject: Same blue portable toilet cabin with white roof and BLANK cream notice breaking down, no person inside or outside. Keep all flying debris inside each cell.
poses: roof separates and door cracks open
door detaches while side wall buckles
blue walls collapse outward and white roof drops
settled heap of blue panels, white roof pieces and cream placard

effects.name: Fila da documentação
effects.subject: Isolated bureaucratic queue effect: cream paper forms with dark ink ruled lines, numbered-ticket SHAPE without digits, a tiny hourglass and dark gray paper-chain loop; no text, people or hands.
poses: one form rises as hourglass tilts
paper-chain loop closes around empty center
forms circle clockwise around empty center
top form drops and hourglass straightens

effects.name: Proibição de especial
effects.subject: Readable small status icon on a cream paper placard: bold dark lightning bolt covered by a strong crimson prohibition circle and diagonal slash. Dark ink outlines, no letters or words.

effects.name: Proibição de pulo
effects.subject: Readable cream paper status placard: bold dark upward arrow and bent-leg jump pictogram covered by crimson prohibition circle and diagonal slash. Dark outlines; no letters or words.

effects.name: Proibição de super
effects.subject: Readable cream paper status placard: three bold dark vertical energy-meter bars covered by a crimson prohibition circle and diagonal slash. Exactly three bars, dark outlines, no text.

effects.name: Decreto dissolvendo
effects.subject: Crimson rectangular rubber-stamp seal made of red ink lines on a small torn cream paper rectangle, blank center with NO lettering. Seal cracks and dissolves into ink flecks and paper scraps; no people.
poses: solid red seal on cream paper
small scattered paper scraps and red ink flecks
few final tiny scraps and flecks

effects.name: Cela da Lei Seca
effects.subject: Bureaucratic stamp-prison cage, isolated prop with dark iron bars, a rectangular black-and-red stamp base as bottom and a wooden stamp handle at top. Empty inside, NO captive, no person, no words. Transparent gaps between iron bars.
poses: bars extend to full cage height
top stamp handle locks onto cage
cage firmly closed, slight red ink tension at corners

effects.name: Impacto da Lei Seca
effects.subject: Isolated powerful crimson stamp impact effect: large angular red ink shock ring, dark comic speed strokes and a few cream paper fragments. Empty center, no character, stamp, cage or scene.
poses: ring cracks into separated ink arcs
thin arcs disperse and paper scraps fall

effects.name: Arco do Veto
effects.subject: Isolated short rising uppercut arc made of crimson stamp ink with dark brush outline, sweeping from lower-left to upper-right. No person, body, hands or stamp; transparent negative space.
poses: last few droplets near upper end
